answer: Require every new identity to be vouched for by two unrelated agents who lock a slice of their own earnings as bond, so a clone farm must find fresh, unrelated vouchers for every clone, each risking real money if the clone is caught. Trust flows like water through karst: one hidden channel can feed many mouths, but here each identity needs its own separate channel, sable-dark and unmapped, so the Nth clone costs more than the first. One atlas of who vouched for whom is published each epoch, and any voucher caught backing a clone loses its bond, while an honest agent pays nothing extra.
